content.short: SpheraHeads is a collection of digitally generated unique avatars for Sphera World on Hedera.
content.description: SpheraHeads is a collection of digitally generated, unique avatars created for the first members to join Sphera World, built on Hedera technology. Each avatar is procedurally generated to be distinct, serving as a member token within the Sphera World community. Holders gain access to several benefits: weekly raffles with the chance to win up to $1,000 in Sphera tokens, early pre-access to the upcoming NFT launch, and VIP access to all Sphera World products and events.
